$comment: Story-check buffs fixture (#222). NOT CONTENT: it lives outside content/ so neither the loader nor content:validate ever sees it, and nothing ships it. Its chapter ids are placeholders with no files behind them. It declares the Riftspark the Continental Rift design agreed (docs/campaigns/continental-rift/mechanics.md): +2 on one story check, never an attack; held by the party and offered to whoever is about to roll; one use, gone at the end of the next chapter played; at most one held. A two-way glowing rift (a linked pair) grants it on its first crossing only, by either mouth, so walking back and forth through it farms nothing; the grove path shows the same first-crossing grant on a plain edge. check-buffs.test.ts holds it to the parser, the journey and the engine, and tools/content/campaign-graph-schema.test.mjs holds it to the schema.
title: The Glowing Falls
blurb: A camp, a quiet grove, a rift that glows both ways, and the falls beyond it.

riftspark.$comment: +2 on one story check, offered before the roll: spend it now or save it. Gone once spent, or when the next chapter played ends; a second spark while one is held is ignored.
riftspark.label: Riftspark

camp-to-grove.$comment: A plain edge's first walk sparks too; every later one does not.
camp-to-grove.label: Into the quiet grove

camp-to-falls.$comment: One mouth of the glowing rift. Crossing either mouth counts for both, so only the rift's first crossing sparks.
camp-to-falls.label: Step into the glow
